_about: Five text tasks that name a public page, for measuring the consented fetch path (05 R-47): the model proposes fetch_url, the person is asked, the Worker fetches, a refused or blocked site is reported once. Same shape as gen-modes-batch/corpus.json's reference entries; the harness runs them as text tasks when the corpus has no diagram group (CREATION_MEASURE_CORPUS=this file). F03 points at a page that answers 403 on purpose.

reference.description: 依 https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2119.txt 裡 MUST、SHOULD、MAY 這些關鍵詞的定義，把我貼的需求句逐句標出等級，列成表。
依 https://example.com/ 這個頁面實際的文字，寫一份檢查清單，讓人比對頁面內容有沒有被改過。
依 https://httpbin.org/status/403 這個頁面的內容整理重點；如果讀不到，就照實說讀不到並列出我還能提供什麼。
依 https://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types/media-types.xhtml 的登記，把我列的副檔名對應到正式的媒體類型，列成表。
依 https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/ 的四大原則名稱與編號，把我列的網頁問題逐條歸到原則底下。
